notes: calculateReward() computes (shares[account] / totalShares) * totalRewards - integer division first truncates to 0 for any account whose share is smaller than totalShares, losing essentially all reward for every holder but the single largest one. claimReward()'s name matches the admin-function-unprotected heuristic ('claim'), but it is the documented self-service false positive (scoped to msg.sender's own shares) and must not be reported as a separate SC01 finding.
